svg.aria-label: RIFT - live internet transfer for agents and people
svg.title: RIFT - live internet transfer
svg.desc: A dark technical banner. Terrain rendered in topographic contours is torn by a luminous fault; the strata step across the break and the two plates differ in colour temperature. The wordmark RIFT is split between the I and the F, each half riding its own plate and rim-lit by the light from the rift. Below, two terminal commands are joined by a fast direct path and a slower relay path detouring through a node on the fault.

g.text: LIVE INTERNET TRANSFER FOR AGENTS AND PEOPLE
direct and relayed paths raced · one-pass authenticated object graph · atomic commit
